note: Research catalogue of candidate datasets (not downloaded). Every hf_id was checked by GET huggingface.co/api/datasets/<id> and datasets-server rows on 2026-10-27; 'yes' in hf_rows_api_works means rows came back without auth. Licences are as stated on cards/READMEs and must be re-checked before any non-research use.

datasets.name: BAND-2k
datasets.annotation_type: MOS 0-100 banding severity + binary patch labels
datasets.harness_use: Primary fit for the banding metric threshold (patch-level visibility labels).

datasets.name: BID
datasets.harness_use: Authentic blur ladder for MTF50 if obtainable.

datasets.name: CID2013
datasets.harness_use: Openly licensed graininess and sharpness attribute MOS for noise/MTF tie margins.

datasets.name: CID22
datasets.harness_use: Modern codec ladder (JPEG/WebP/AVIF/JXL) for the JPEG-artifact threshold.

datasets.name: CSIQ
datasets.harness_use: Secondary fit for noise (white + pink), Gaussian blur and JPEG; includes contrast change for a partial clipping proxy.

datasets.name: FGRestore
datasets.harness_use: Pairwise prefs on restoration outputs; secondary BT sanity on restoration artifacts.

datasets.name: FLIVE / PaQ-2-PiQ
datasets.harness_use: Patch-level MOS lets local metrics (shadow SNR, texture) be fitted per region.

datasets.name: HRIQ
datasets.harness_use: High-res authentic MOS cross-check.

datasets.name: IQA-Dataset labels
datasets.harness_use: Pull labels for 10 classic IQA sets via rows API without downloading images.

datasets.name: chaofengc IQA aggregate
datasets.harness_use: One-stop mirror of TID2013/KADID/CSIQ/LIVE/PIPAL/SPAQ/FLIVE tgz files.

datasets.name: ISRGen-QA
datasets.harness_use: Diffusion-SR texture artifacts MOS.

datasets.name: KADID-10k
datasets.license: no formal licence; freely available to the research community
datasets.n_annotations: 30 DCRs per image (~303,750); worker count not stated
datasets.harness_use: Only labelled graded source for sharpening halo (High sharpen); also fits MTF50/blur (Gaussian, lens, motion), banding, noise and JPEG thresholds.

datasets.name: KADIS-700k
datasets.harness_use: Unlabelled ladders for metric unit tests only.

datasets.name: KonIQ-10k
datasets.license: no formal licence (DaRUS mirror CC BY 4.0)
datasets.harness_use: Authentic-camera prior for aggregate thresholds; use with KonIQ++ defect labels.

datasets.name: KonIQ++
datasets.annotation_type: 5-pt MOS + defect distributions (blur, artifacts, colour, contrast, other)
datasets.harness_use: Per-defect human probabilities for calibrating blur/artifact metric thresholds on authentic images.

datasets.name: LIVE In-the-Wild Challenge
datasets.harness_use: Authentic-capture sanity set for metric monotonicity.

datasets.name: LIVE IQA Release 2
datasets.license: UT Austin copyright notice; research use
datasets.harness_use: Classic cross-check for JPEG/blur/noise thresholds; small and well-studied.

datasets.name: LIVE Multiply Distorted
datasets.harness_use: Tests metric additivity when blur co-occurs with JPEG or noise.

datasets.name: PIPAL
datasets.harness_use: Fit texture-fidelity and GAN/diffusion artifact thresholds against Elo of GAN-SR outputs.

datasets.name: PIQ23
datasets.harness_use: Expert pairwise JOD on identical scenes across phones is the closest analogue to 'better than a lens' comparisons.

datasets.name: Krasula sharpened-image DB
datasets.harness_use: Would be the only sharpening-specific MOS set; currently unobtainable.

datasets.name: SPAQ
datasets.annotation_type: MOS 0-100 + attribute MOS (brightness, colourfulness, contrast, noisiness, sharpness) + EXIF
datasets.harness_use: Fit shadow-SNR (noisiness) and MTF50 (sharpness) tie margins on real phone output with EXIF ISO.

datasets.name: SR artifact dataset (arXiv 2510.16752)
datasets.harness_use: Binary artifact-visibility votes for texture-fidelity threshold.

datasets.name: TID2013
datasets.license: none stated; freely available for scientific purposes
datasets.n_annotations: 985 subjective experiments (paper); ~524k pairwise comparisons (site claim, unverified)
datasets.harness_use: Fit noise, quantisation/banding, blur and JPEG thresholds against graded synthetic MOS; 5 levels per type give monotonic ladders.

datasets.name: UHD-IQA
datasets.harness_use: High-resolution authentic set closest to the harness's 4K generated outputs.

datasets.name: AGIN (AI-Generated Image Naturalness)
datasets.license: unknown (no licence file per GitHub API; README states none)
datasets.n_items: 6,049 AIGIs (+200 real calibration images) from 18 model variants across 5 tasks (T2I: SD1.5, SD2.1, Openjourney, Dreamlike, Realistic Vision; translation; inpainting RePaint/MAT; colorization; editing DragGAN/InstructPix2Pix/MagicBrush) — https://arxiv.org/html/2312.05476v3
datasets.n_annotations: 907,350 ratings = 6,049 x 30 subjects x (3 scores + 2 factor picks); 30 campus subjects — https://arxiv.org/html/2312.05476v3
datasets.annotation_type: in-lab single-stimulus 1-5 ratings for overall naturalness, technical quality, rationality + per-image 'main factor' pick (technical: luminance, contrast, detail, blur, artifacts; rationality: existence, color, layout, context, sensory clarity); MOS released
datasets.access: direct-download (SJTU Netdisk password vsg6; Baidu password riha) — China-hosted only
datasets.harness_use: Main-factor votes tell which technical defect dominates an AIGI.
datasets.notes: Only AIGI MOS set with a per-image technical-factor label separating blur vs artifacts vs luminance/contrast/detail (global, not regional). Includes GAN-based editing (DragGAN).

datasets.harness_use: Small AIGI MOS sanity set.

datasets.name: AGIQA-3K
datasets.hf_id: strawhat/agiqa-3k (UNOFFICIAL mirror; no official HF upload)

datasets.license: MIT (GitHub repo license via GitHub API; mirror tagged license:mit)

datasets.n_annotations: 125,244 ratings = 2 dims x 21 raters x 2,982 images; 21 graduate students (10M/11F, 6 nationalities), 14 sessions, ITU-R BT.500-13 lab — https://arxiv.org/html/2306.04717

datasets.notes: Includes one GAN model (AttnGAN) so GAN vs diffusion artifact contrast is possible at image level. Perception MOS explicitly covers 'technical issues, AI artifacts, deepfake-like realism, aesthetics' combined — not separable.

datasets.annotation_type: per-image multi-label artifact categories with text descriptions; provenance (human vs VLM-generated) UNKNOWN
datasets.access: HF rows API works without auth
datasets.harness_use: Only set naming texture repetition / over-sharpening, but provenance unverified; pseudo-labels at best.
datasets.notes: The only set whose label vocabulary matches sharpening/banding/noise/repetition — but no documentation, no licence, and labels look VLM-generated. Treat as unverified pseudo-labels.

datasets.name: DatapointAI Text-to-Image Human Preferences 2M (2026)
datasets.hf_split: train | test (50 held-out prompts: 21,663 pairs / 216,630 responses)
datasets.hf_rows_api_works: gated (datasets-server: not accessible without authentication; manual approval)
datasets.license: CC-BY-4.0 for votes/prompts/metadata; images under each model provider's terms — card
datasets.n_items: 216,116 pairs covering all 435 pairings of 30 models (full round-robin), 500 prompts (10 categories), one image per model per prompt, fixed seed — card
datasets.n_annotations: 2,161,160 votes, exactly 10 per pair; annotators from >200 countries (count not stated); 18.2% of pairs tied on raw votes (label 0.5/0.5) — card
datasets.annotation_type: pairwise preference; responses table has pair_key, chosen, annotator (salted hash, stable), trust_score (0-1), time_taken_ms, country; pairs table has votes_a/b, trust-weighted votes, winner
datasets.access: HF gated (manual approval, must accept conditions)
datasets.harness_use: Ideal BT validation (round-robin, fixed 10 votes/pair, rater ids, ties) if access is granted.
datasets.notes: Self-reported, 2026, not peer-reviewed; but it is the only dataset with stable rater hashes + fixed 10 votes/pair + ties + full round-robin — purpose-built for BT/Elo validation. Leaderboard snapshot 2026-08-19.

datasets.notes: No GitHub/HF found.

datasets.name: HPD v2 (Human Preference Dataset v2)
datasets.hf_rows_api_works: no (official viewer disabled: 'runs arbitrary python code'); yes for mirror zhwang/HPDv2 default/test (400 rows: prompt, image_path, raw_annotations[{annotation, user_hash}], rank)
datasets.n_items: 433,760 images (paper inconsistent: 'pairs' in abstract, 'images' in datasheet); 107,515 train prompt groups + 400 test groups (9 images each, 100 COCO groups +1 real photo) — https://arxiv.org/html/2306.09341
